messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT — SLO burn detected: hosted-infer-usw2 p99 latency > 2s and 5xx jump to 3.1% over 5m :rotating_light:
olivia_nguyen: Seeing support ticket 4721 complaining about timeouts, likely customers hitting p99. Any fast checks?
samir: I opened the dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/hosted-infer/usw2-latency — tail shows a spike at 12:32 UTC. 5xx are mostly 502/504.
olivia_nguyen: Any trace coverage? customers say traces are missing for a lot of requests.
samir: Tracing gap confirmed. A bunch of ingress requests have no spans past gateway. Query I ran:
```
service:gateway AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599] AND region:usw2 | top(status, 10) | count()
```
no corresponding backend spans for many trace IDs, looks like proxy returned before envoy forwarded.
maria_p: FWIW support found correlation: several requests have `x-customer-billing` header present. Billing API returned 502 recently (see infra incident). Could be cascade.
kevin_s: If billing is erroring, gateway might be timing out waiting for a sync call. Can we confirm any sync calls to billing in the request path?
samir: Yes, quick grep of recent config shows `proxy->billing: syncQuotas` call in middleware for authenticated customers. Logs show middleware attempts, then gateway handshake resets. Sample log snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T12:31:58Z gateway middleware quota_sync start req=abc123 customer=acme
2026-03-15T12:32:00Z billing service 502 resp to gateway req=abc123
2026-03-15T12:32:00Z gateway middleware quota_sync error upstream_reset req=abc123
```
olivia_nguyen: That matches support repro. Customer SDKs get 504s. Quick mitigation: can we short-circuit quota check for hosted tier customers for now? Or fallback to cached quotas?
kevin_s: We have a feature flag `quota_cache_fallback`—I can flip it for usw2 for 5m. That should reduce sync calls and drop cascade. Will do now.
kevin_s: flipped flag for region=usw2, scope=hosted, expiry=5m :white_check_mark:
maria_p: Notifying affected customers and support with mitigation steps.
samir: Also recommend we add a probe that runs the full request path including quota sync to detect this earlier. Current probes only check gateway health, not middleware syncs.
olivia_nguyen: Good call. Action items: 1) add a synthetic probe for quota sync route, 2) create runbook to flip fallback flag, 3) root cause triage with billing team. I'll open a JIRA and assign.
maria_p: Link to support ticket and customer notification sent.
samir: For postmortem: we'll need traces for 12:30–12:40. If trace sampling dropped, add a temporary sampler increase for gateway to capture next window.
kevin_s: Increasing gateway trace sampling to 50% for 30 minutes.
kevin_s: sampling update applied :rocket:
olivia_nguyen: Thanks team — keeping this thread open until we have RC and postmortem owner.
oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03-15-34, severity: P2.
maria_p: I'll own customer comms and JIRA. Assigning to `infra/billing` for RCA.
kevin_s: Will follow up with a short playbook for future quick toggles.
olivia_nguyen: Closing monitoring loop: verify 5xx back to baseline and SLO stable for 30m, then remove flag.
(ends)
